commit.message:
crypto/ec/ec_key.c: Reject invalid group order during key generation

An EC group with order 1 provides no valid private key value.  Passing
this empty range to BN_priv_rand_range_ex() causes key generation
to loop indefinitely.

Reject the invalid effective order in the EC key-generation path,
preserving EC_GROUP_set_generator() compatibility.  Add a regression
test covering this boundary.

Fixes: CVE-2026-107496
Resolves: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/33497
